chapterTexts: The lightweight native installers create a private Python three point twelve runtime, then download Qt, PyTorch, spaCR, and its dependencies.
Download installers only from the latest spaCR GitHub Release. Match the file to your operating system and use the published SHA-256 file when you need to verify the download.
On Windows ten or eleven, open the online setup executable. Automatic hardware acceleration is selected by default. Clear that component only when you require a smaller CPU-only installation.
On macOS eleven or newer, open the universal package for Intel and Apple silicon. If Gatekeeper blocks the unnotarized package, use Privacy and Security, Open Anyway, then run it again.

On sixty four bit Linux, make the downloaded .run file executable, then start it from a terminal. Automatic backend selection is the default and installs CUDA support when compatible NVIDIA hardware is available.
To require a smaller CPU-only installation on Linux, pass --torch-backend cpu. Otherwise, keep the default automatic selection so CUDA acceleration is used when supported.
Each installer validates the replacement before switching versions. An interrupted update leaves the previous environment intact, and install.log remains in the private spaCR installation directory.
After installation, use the operating system launcher. No separate Python or Conda setup is required.
